title: SMCEvolve: Principled Scientific Discovery via Sequential Monte Carlo Evolution

mechanism.populationDetail: SMC maintains a particle population representing candidate programs; no islands or explicit genealogy are stated.
mechanism.archiveDetail: The evidence note describes weighted particle state, not a separate elite archive.
mechanism.replacementDetail: Adaptive resampling updates particle composition and proposal acceptance/rejection controls particle admission; the exact survivor/update schedule is not detailed in the evidence note.
mechanism.generationDetail: Candidate programs are proposed through a mixture of mutation kernels applied to selected particles.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Reward updates bridging distributions and particle weights; population/search state updates kernel selection.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: Adaptive importance-weight resampling selects particles from the current population; exact resampling scheme not stated.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: Sequential Monte Carlo reward-tilted distributions, bridging, particle resampling, Thompson kernel control, and automatic convergence stopping.

provenance.sourcePdf: additional_papers/202605/SMCEvolve Principled Scientific Discovery via Sequential Monte Carlo Evolution.pdf
provenance.citationWarning: Population/resampling is clear at summary level, but specific replacement schedule and procedure subtype need method verification; do not treat kernel selection and parent selection as the same mechanism.
